name: magzhan
description: A personal Claude Code marketplace — plugins for my own projects

plugins.name: stage-pipeline
plugins.description: A staged maker/checker workflow for large UI tasks: splitting into stages, a spec from the design, checks by subagents (Figma/prototype, runtime, code review, dead code, i18n, dependencies), an autonomous force run, a state journal kept in files and a PR description

plugins.name: human-text
plugins.description: Rules for writing work text people actually read (status updates, handoffs, docs) and a closed-question check of a draft in a clean context

plugins.name: design-pipeline
plugins.description: Design before code for projects without a designer: an interview that turns an order into a brief, a design system picked from rendered directions, clickable HTML prototypes per flow, a clean-context design review, and a handoff that stage-pipeline reads as its prototype design source

plugins.name: product-pipeline
plugins.description: Product work before code, for the product owner: intake of a stakeholder's ask, discovery with sourced facts, a brief with a lint and a clean-context review, stakeholder decisions, the split into tickets, Jira (manual mode first), and a handoff that stage-pipeline's /stage-plan reads
